title: Finite cone construction of a shifted constructible coefficient sheaf
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, and let $\Lambda=E$ for a finite intermediate extension $\mathbf Q_\ell\subset E\subset \overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, or $\Lambda=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with the recorded condensed coefficient sheaves. Let $M$ be a constructible $\Lambda_X$-module in the finite constant scalar model convention [sk-def-sfb-constructible], let $n\in\mathbf Z$, and let $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] be isomorphic to $M[0][n]$. There exist $N\geq0$ and objects $F_0,\ldots,F_N$ with $F_N=K$ such that each $F_r$ is either isomorphic to $a_!L[m]$ for a locally closed immersion $a:S\hookrightarrow X$, a lisse $\Lambda_S$-module $L$, and $m\in\mathbf Z$ [sk-lem-coefficient-heart; det-lem-coefficient-heart-filtration], or belongs to a distinguished triangle $F_i\to F_j\to F_r[m]\to F_i[1]$ for some $i,j<r$ and $m\in\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-triangulated-category].

source.place: Single sheaves paragraph: filtration, short exact sequence triangles and shifts

proof.text: Unfold the finite-constant-model constructibility predicate on a Noetherian scheme to obtain a finite adapted stratification. Forget only its constructibility fields using a generic predicate on immersions, then apply the common-stratification assertion to obtain open prefixes and lisse refined restrictions. Finite free scalar models give adaptedness for the filtration theorem.

Apply the counit-image filtration theorem. Its endpoints are bottom and top subobjects, its inclusions are monomorphisms, and its successive cokernels are the specified locally closed extensions of lisse restrictions.

Concatenate finite witnesses with Fin.append and append each cone with Fin.snoc. Each subobject inclusion and its cokernel form a short exact sequence. Shift its degree-zero distinguished triangle and inversely rotate it; natural-number induction constructs the tower. The zero lisse module gives the initial generator. Prove preservation of zero by the locally closed extension first for a generic condensed ring to avoid unfolding coefficient instances.

Use shift-addition isomorphisms for the shifted quotient generators. Identify the top subobject with M and append a distinguished contractible triangle to transport the last vertex through each isomorphism, including the given isomorphism to K. The zero-object base also handles empty or non-strict filtrations and rank-zero quotients.

theorem coefficientHeart_sheaf_cone_witness (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) RingCat.{u + 1})
    [IsCommMonObj (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ)]
    (hΛ : (∃ E : IntermediateField ℚ_[ℓ] (PadicAlgCl ℓ),
      FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E ∧ Λ = Profinite.padicSubfieldCondensedRing ℓ E) ∨
      Λ = Profinite.padicAlgClCondensedRing ℓ)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) X))
    (hM : IsConstantModelConstructible (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) X M)
    (n : ℤ) (K : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) X)))
    (hK : Nonempty (K ≅ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)⟦n⟧)) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (F : Fin (N + 1) → DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) X))),
      F (Fin.last N) = K ∧ ∀ r : Fin (N + 1),
        (∃ (S : Scheme.{u}) (a : S ⟶ X) (ha : IsImmersion a)
          (L : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1})
            (condensedRingObj (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) S)) (n : ℤ),
          IsLisseCoefficientModule (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) L ∧
            Nonempty (F r ≅ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
              ((coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension
                (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) a ha).obj L))⟦n⟧)) ∨
        (∃ (i j : Fin (N + 1)), i < r ∧ j < r ∧
          ∃ (n : ℤ) (f : F i ⟶ F j) (g : F j ⟶ (F r)⟦n⟧)
            (h : (F r)⟦n⟧ ⟶ (F i)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
            Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk f g h ∈ distTriang _)
